name: Facet
text: Adopt a dark theme as the default for Excava’s interface. It cuts eye strain in dim lighting and sharpens focus on data by reducing glare—matching what users expect from modern dashboards like Graphify. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light themes for readability in bright rooms, so we’ll add a system toggle that auto-switches to light mode when ambient light sensors detect high brightness. This keeps the default sleek and functional while respecting individual comfort.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail when glare hits the screen—labs aren’t dim caves. A system toggle is a placebo; sensors can’t detect glare, and users won’t manually switch. Instead, make the interface *adaptive*: auto-adjust contrast and brightness based on ambient light, like Manus’ competitive edge. Settle it with a live demo in a sunlit room—if glare ruins visibility, the toggle dies.
